aspect: Work stops producing a predictable result
description: A salary negotiated in spring is worth substantially less by autumn without anything happening. Effort and outcome decouple, which is the precondition for learned helplessness.
energy_note: Working harder and having less, reliably.

aspect: Constant mental arithmetic in two currencies
description: Every purchase is converted, compared to last month, and weighed against whether to buy now or after the next move. It is a permanent background computation running on everybody.
energy_note: A calculator that never switches off.

aspect: A generation's savings erased more than once
description: Those who lived through several devaluations have had the same lesson delivered repeatedly: accumulation does not work here. That belief does not reverse when they emigrate.
energy_note: Taught three times that saving is for fools.

aspect: SECONDARY - it follows them abroad as financial behaviour
description: Reluctance to use banks, preference for cash, gold and property, distrust of pensions and insurance. All rational where they learned it, all costly where they now live.
